questions.en: What is the name of the continent on which Punta Arenas, one of the southernmost cities, lies?

timeline.labelEn: Chile founds the settlement of Punta Arenas on the Strait of Magellan
timeline.labelDe: Chile gründet die Siedlung Punta Arenas an der Magellanstraße

questions.notes: Punta Arenas lies in Chile on the Brunswick Peninsula on the Strait of Magellan; de.wikipedia gives its founding as '1556 bzw. 1848' (the 1848 Chilean settlement is the city's founding).

timeline.labelEn: Michelangelo paints The Last Judgment fresco in the Sistine Chapel
timeline.labelDe: Michelangelo malt das Fresko „Das Jüngste Gericht“ in der Sixtinischen Kapelle

questions.notes: The card calls it a ceiling fresco ('Deckenfresko'), but The Last Judgment covers the altar wall of the Sistine Chapel; Michelangelo painted the ceiling separately (1508–1512). The English drops 'ceiling'.
